The Richmonder is excited to announce the launch of its public notice platform.

In 2024, Virginia Code § 8.01-324 expanded the definition of newspaper of record to include online-only news outlets that meet an extensive criteria of serving the public through their reporting.

The Richmonder was certified as meeting that criteria by circuit courts in Richmond, Henrico and Hanover, and expects certification in Chesterfield imminently.

Public notices received by The Richmonder will be displayed in our new Public Notices section.

Send your written notice via email to: legal@richmonder.org or use The Richmonder's website tool.

Allow three business days for publication.

A notarized affidavit and copy of the notice will be sent via email.

The cost is $150 per notice and can be paid online or by check. This is often a significant discount over print-based notices.

Each notice will reside and be searchable on The Richmonder website.

Notices will also be uploaded to the state's online repository.

Please send questions to Beth Weisbrod, Director of Growth:  bweisbrod@richmonder.org

Love what we’re doing? Want more? Sign up for our email newsletter. It’s free.

Support quality local news.
